convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load Kolier_SuperTrend custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution logic (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose). Both must be manually replicated in Python.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA starts trading
derived_values.used_by: OnTick bar sufficiency check and historical bar search offset

other_exits: Close long if DnTrend buffer (index 1) is non-zero on signal bar (trend reversed to downtrend, no fresh signal needed)
Close short if UpTrend buffer (index 0) is non-zero on signal bar (trend reversed to uptrend, no fresh signal needed)
BuyPosClose and SellPosClose input booleans gate whether signal-reversal closes are actually executed

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative values are treated as fixed lot size (e.g. -0.1 = 0.1 lots), positive values are treated as deposit fraction for risk-based sizing. Logic handled inside TradeAlgorithms.mqh

custom_logic_notes: The Kolier_SuperTrend custom indicator exposes 4 buffers: buffer 0 = UpTrend line values, buffer 1 = DnTrend line values, buffer 2 = UpSignal (non-zero on bar where trend flips to up), buffer 3 = DnSignal (non-zero on bar where trend flips to down). Exit logic is dual: (1) on fresh reversal signal (UpSignal/DnSignal non-zero), both close opposite and open new position; (2) on sustained opposite trend without fresh signal (UpTrend/DnTrend non-zero), only close opposite position without opening new. Signal timestamps (UpSignalTime, DnSignalTime) are passed to trade open functions, likely for bar-time-based trade filtering inside TradeAlgorithms.mqh. The iCustom call passes parameter '3' as the first custom param (likely the indicator's own time frame or mode param). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans independently gate each trade action.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate Kolier_SuperTrend indicator logic in Python (ATR-based SuperTrend with multiplier). The custom indicator has 4 buffers that must be computed: up_trend_line, dn_trend_line, up_signal_flag, dn_signal_flag. TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions must be replaced - BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen handle MM logic (negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction) plus SL/TP placement; BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose handle position closing with deviation. The CIsNewBar class and LoadHistory function must also be replicated for new-bar detection and history synchronization. No digit adjustment is performed on SL/TP values, so 1000 points SL / 2000 points TP are raw point values (100 pips SL / 200 pips TP on 5-digit broker).
